turns.user: does that change what I'm eating as well, or just the training?
turns.reply:
It changes both. 

On the training side, your plan will rebuild from this week forward to focus on muscle growth—shifting the volume, the phases, and the rep ranges to support building size. 

On the nutrition side, it updates your targets to put you in a calorie surplus. To build muscle, your body needs that extra energy, so your daily target will go up from your current 1,660 calories, and your meals will scale up to match those new numbers. 

None of your past logged weeks or meals will be touched, but everything going forward will adjust to support the new goal. Once you tap confirm on that card, we'll be fully set up for the build.
